Element.Description: Audio volume for gameEnding_Part3.thp. Only the low eight bits are passed to the movie player. This segment precedes the credits, with the special ending inserted when selected.

Audio volume for all three completion-screen movies: Win_Movie_begin, Win_Movie_loop and Win_Movie_end. Only the low eight bits are used. MovieVolumeCompletionScreenMusic controls the separate music track.
Audio volume for afterCredits_100.thp. Only the low eight bits are passed to the movie player.
Volume of Audio/echoes-end1-32.dsp during the credits. Only the low eight bits are passed to the audio player.
Volume of Audio/samusjak_edit.dsp on the completion screen. Only the low eight bits are passed to the audio player. MovieVolumeCompletionScreen controls the separate movie audio.
